name: pokemon-locations-version-multiplex
description: Multiplex encounter hypergraph with PokéAPI Pokémon entries as nodes and game versions as layers. In each layer, a hyperedge corresponds to one location area and contains the Pokémon encounterable there in that game version. Location areas with the same Pokémon set in the same layer are collapsed into one hyperedge; list-valued edge metadata records all represented location areas.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., pokemon-locations-version-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).
hypergraph_metadata.layer_type: (STRING) Semantic type of multiplex layers (e.g., version).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Pokémon name (e.g., pikachu).
nodes_metadata.generation: (STRING) Generation where the Pokémon species was introduced (e.g., generation-i).
nodes_metadata.is_default: (BOOL) Whether this is the default Pokémon form (e.g., true).
nodes_metadata.secondary_type: (STRING) Secondary Pokémon type when present (e.g., flying).

edges_metadata.location_area_ids: (LIST[INT]) PokéAPI location-area identifiers represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [285]).
edges_metadata.area_names: (LIST[STRING]) Location area names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pallet-town-area]).
edges_metadata.location_names: (LIST[STRING]) Parent location names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pallet-town]).
edges_metadata.versions: (STRING) Game version represented by the multiplex layer (e.g., red).
edges_metadata.encounter_methods: (LIST[STRING]) Encounter methods represented by the incidence (e.g., [walk]).
edges_metadata.n_observations: (INT) Number of raw PokéAPI encounter observations aggregated into the hyperedge (e.g., 12).
